actions.body:
Dev run 20261019T024444Z-dev-8a7a answers the Reviewer's review on PR #2 (head 9acac6e). No change is made to the pull request.

Finding 1 asks for a test that sub(-1, -1) is 0. UC-1's Done-when names three cases: sub(5, 3) is 2, sub(3, 5) is -2 and sub(0, 0) is 0, each in its own test. Those three are tested in test/sub.test.js, and the gate passes. No accepted decision record or use case asks for sub(-1, -1). The only text that asks for it is in the Reviewer's own instructions (.orus/agents/reviewer.md), not in the use case, so I have not added it. The owner decides whether to add that case: if so, UC-1 should name it, and the Tests column should list test/sub.test.js once the pull request is merged.
